_comment: Papers that are implementation foundations (libraries, optimizers, generic training techniques) rather than research-line predecessors of any specific topic. They get pulled into theme lineages because every modern ML paper cites them with a 'methodology' intent — which our normal foundational-cite filter respects, so we override that here with an explicit denylist. See paperpilot/scripts/build_theme_lineage.py::_is_implementation_foundation.
